resurrection.source: health.py RenewRSI_DirectObject sets both live maxima and expressly selects ReviveRSIAbility 375 for the standing resurrection motion. The approval and both result strings name Renew 438.
resurrection.runtime: AbilityResurrection.Reply applies the accepted offer, and Present uses MotionAbility(438) for the stand while keeping 438 in the caster and recipient result RPCs.
resurrection.test: RenewNativeReplyKeepsItsOwnResultAndUsesTheReviveMotion observes the 438 offer, full current HP/IS, stock 375 action 63, restore FX and both 438 result records. PR820 stock verifies the equivalent 375 stand and the shared visible resurrection family. Per-ability Renew targeting and cast timing in the stock UI remain unobserved. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/820#issuecomment-7086365203

script.source: health.py RenewRSI_DirectObject resuscitates and fills live maxima, plays the Restore RSI effect and 375 standing motion, sends 438 results, and applies 1208 when the recipient is PvP-flagged.
script.runtime: The ordinary 81 88 dispatch reaches AbilityResurrection.Reply and publishes the callback only after consent. The recipient keeps its flag and Death Effect, and the flagged recipient applies the equivalent flag-only action to the caster.
script.test: RenewNativeReplyKeepsItsOwnResultAndUsesTheReviveMotion exercises the actual dispatcher with the PR290 consent body and the offered 438 id. It verifies accept, decline, duplicate protection, both recipient flags and 438's callback output. PR696 witnesses the shared 1208 flag propagation on stock Restore. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/290#issuecomment-6974177832 https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/696#issuecomment-7069292847

behavior-tests.source: GOB 438 uses the ordinary resurrection family and health.py gives its full post-consent behavior, including the 375 motion alias.
behavior-tests.runtime: AbilityResurrection.CanTarget admits dead friendly characters, Request and Reply fence the live offer, and the accepted callback fills current maxima and publishes owner state with the sourced motion and effects.
behavior-tests.test: CorpseGateChecksDeadFriendlyRangeAndWorldState covers admission. RenewNativeReplyKeepsItsOwnResultAndUsesTheReviveMotion changes the live maxima after the offer and verifies one restore only if consent, no change on decline, exact self vitals and motion, restore FX, both result records and conditional PvP. PR820's stock 375 verifies the specific movement context while PR290 and PR321 verify the stock Rejuvenate consent and full maxima used by the family. The first complete native Renew cast is still outstanding. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/820#issuecomment-7086365203 https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/290#issuecomment-6974177832 https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/321#issuecomment-7001527488
